title: Basic Commands [wc, $?]
description:
# wc
`wc` stands for **word count**. It counts lines, words, and characters:
```bash
wc filename
# 10  50  300  filename
# lines  words  bytes
```

Useful flags:
- `wc -l` - lines only
- `wc -w` - words only
- `wc -c` - bytes only

# Exit codes ($?)
Every command returns an exit code when it finishes:
- `0` = success
- anything else = failure

```bash
ls /real/directory
echo $?    # 0 (success)

ls /fake/directory
echo $?    # 2 (no such file)
```

`$?` holds the exit code of the LAST command. It's how scripts check if something worked.
